from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
print('HEAD',subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip())
print('ORIGIN_MAIN',subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','origin/main'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip())
print('DIRTY',subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)
terms=('salary','compensation','quick-first','quick_first','application_duration','estimated_minutes','long_application')
for sub in ('core','tests'):
 hits=[]
 for p in sorted((repo/sub).glob('*.py')):
  try:lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
  except UnicodeError:continue
  match=[(i+1,line.strip()[:145]) for i,line in enumerate(lines) if any(term in line.lower() for term in terms)]
  if match:hits.append((str(p.relative_to(repo)),match[:5]))
 print('AREA',sub,'FILES_WITH_TERMS',len(hits))
 for path,items in hits[:35]:print('HIT',path,items)
print('SCOPE','read-only inspect qualification and queue throughput roadmap gap; no credentials, browser or application actions')
